findings.claim: Capital One 已把約 2,500 萬張簽帳卡換到 Discover 網路；Q2 2026 財報會上表示開始測試把部分信用卡由 Visa 移到 Discover 網路（新發卡與既有帳戶轉換），尚未公布最終轉移量與時程。
findings.source: PaymentsJournal｜After moving debit cards to Discover, Capital One turns to credit card migration

findings.claim: Q1 2026 財報報導：新發行卡預計於 Q3 底前全數走 Discover 網路，全組合轉換至 2027 Q1；營收年減 2% 至 152 億美元，管理層歸因於 Discover 網路與 Brex 的轉換成本。
findings.source: eMarketer｜Capital One Q1 2026 earnings reflect tightened underwriting, groundwork for Discover transition

findings.claim: Capital One 宣布以 51.5 億美元收購企業費用管理平台 Brex（27.5 億現金加約 1,060 萬股），延伸至中小企業與商業客戶的平台化布局。
findings.source: PYMNTS｜Capital One Plans to Acquire Expense Management Platform Brex for $5.15 Billion

findings.claim: Capital One 開始測試將信用卡移至 Discover 網路
findings.excerpt: Legacy Discover card loans declined 1.5% from a year earlier, while ending loans excluding Discover increased about 5.3%. Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank said Discover remains in what Capital One has called a “brownout” in loan growth during the integration.

note: 摘錄為搜尋摘要轉述，無可逐字複製原文；Brex 交割日期未由一手來源確認。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
